name: blueprint
description: From the first message to a staged plan: a context derived before it is asked, a plan built on written best practices, a fixed loop for every stage, and a decisions folder when the project needs one.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Blueprint panel beside the chat when a session starts in a project that has a plan.

notifyWhenWaiting.title: Notify me when it is my turn
notifyWhenWaiting.description: Send a push notification (phone, via Remote Control) once when a stage or a child session starts waiting for you. Skipped while you are looking at the session.
